title: Senotherapy: The battle for quality vs quantity of life
abstract: * **UBX1325 for Ophthalmological indications including Diabetic Macular Oedema (DMO) and neovascular age-related macular degeneration led by Unity Biotechnology** – UBX1325 is a BCL-xl inhibitor that promotes apoptosis of senescent cells and Unity Biotechnology’s lead candidate. D+Q is currently undergoing phase II trials in individuals with diabetic kidney disease using the hit and run approach, a preliminary report indicated that markers of the SASP and other senescence markers were decreased, the study will also evaluate frailty and renal function after 14 days.52 Dasatinib and/or quercetin are also undergoing Phase II trials in Osteopaenia, Alzheimer’s disease and Frailty in Childhood Cancer survivors.53,54,55 It is worth noting that dasatinib and quercetin have been trialed in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis with mixed success. * **OpRegen for Geographic Atrophy** in dry age-related macular degeneration (AMD) led by Lineage Cell Therapeutics – Lineage Cell Therapeutics in partnership with Roche and Genentech has developed human embryonic stem cell-derived retinal pigment epithelial cells which when delivered surgically to AMD patients with GA has been shown to improve visual function and retinal structure for up to 4 years in a Phase I trial.
